title: COPD flare, steroid taper, French
source:
DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS
Patient: Pierre Martin   MRN: 30411876
Attending: Dr. Laura Chen

Diagnosis: COPD exacerbation triggered by a viral chest infection.

MEDICATIONS
NEW: Prednisone 40 mg by mouth once daily with breakfast for 5 days, then stop. Last dose 10/18/2026.
NEW: Tiotropium 2 puffs inhaled once daily.
CHANGED: Albuterol inhaler 2 puffs every 4 hours as needed for shortness of breath (was every 6 hours).
STOP: Ipratropium inhaler - do not use together with tiotropium.

Do not smoke. Smoking cessation clinic referral sent.
Return precautions: Call 911 for severe shortness of breath, blue lips, or confusion. Call your doctor if you need albuterol more than every 4 hours or have fever above 38.5 C.

Follow-up: Pulmonary clinic with Dr. Chen on 10/30/2026. Pulmonary rehabilitation intake on 11/04/2026.
